```javascript
#targetengine "session"
/**
 * Converts a facing-pages document to single-page format
 * Preserves: All page items (including master items as static content), layers, positioning, margins, columns, and visual layout
 * Note: Master page *links* are intentionally broken (items become static) to maintain pixel-perfect layout in single-page context
 */
(function () {
    if (app.documents.length === 0) {
        alert("❌ No document open.\nPlease open a facing-pages document first.");
        return;
    }

    const origDoc = app.activeDocument;
    if (!origDoc.documentPreferences.facingPages) {
        alert("ℹ️ Document is already single-page format.\nNo conversion needed.");
        return;
    }

    if (!confirm(
        "⚠️ CREATION MODE: New Document\n\n" +
        "This will create a NEW single-page document preserving:\n" +
        "• All page/master items (as static content)\n" +
        "• Layers, positioning & pasteboard items\n" +
        "• Page-specific margins/columns\n" +
        "• Object styles, effects, and transparency\n\n" +
        "❌ Original document remains UNCHANGED\n" +
        "✅ SAVE your work before proceeding\n\n" +
        "Continue with conversion?",
        "Convert Spreads to Single Pages",
        true
    )) return;

    // Create progress UI
    const progressWin = new Window("palette", "Converting Pages...", undefined, {closeButton: false});
    progressWin.progress = progressWin.add("progressbar", [15, 15, 385, 35], 0, origDoc.pages.length);
    progressWin.info = progressWin.add("statictext", [15, 45, 385, 65], "Initializing...", {multiline: true});
    progressWin.cancel = progressWin.add("button", [150, 75, 250, 100], "Cancel");
    progressWin.cancel.onClick = () => { progressWin.close(); };
    progressWin.show();
    progressWin.update();

    let newDoc, hasCancelled = false;
    progressWin.cancel.enabled = true;

    try {
        // Create target document with matching base settings
        newDoc = app.documents.add({
            documentPreferences: {
                pageWidth: origDoc.documentPreferences.pageWidth,
                pageHeight: origDoc.documentPreferences.pageHeight,
                facingPages: false,
                pageOrientation: origDoc.documentPreferences.pageOrientation,
                pagesPerDocument: 1
            },
            marginPreferences: { // Base margins (page-specific will override)
                top: origDoc.marginPreferences.top,
                bottom: origDoc.marginPreferences.bottom,
                left: origDoc.marginPreferences.left,
                right: origDoc.marginPreferences.right,
                columnCount: origDoc.marginPreferences.columnCount,
                columnGutter: origDoc.marginPreferences.columnGutter
            }
        });
        newDoc.viewPreferences.horizontalMeasurementUnits = origDoc.viewPreferences.horizontalMeasurementUnits;
        newDoc.viewPreferences.verticalMeasurementUnits = origDoc.viewPreferences.verticalMeasurementUnits;
        newDoc.zeroPoint = origDoc.zeroPoint; // Preserve ruler origin

        // Remove default page
        newDoc.pages[0].remove();

        // Duplicate pages with progress tracking
        for (let i = 0; i < origDoc.pages.length; i++) {
            if (progressWin !== null && progressWin.enabled === false) {
                hasCancelled = true;
                break;
            }

            progressWin.progress.value = i + 1;
            progressWin.info.text = `Processing page ${i + 1} of ${origDoc.pages.length}...`;
            progressWin.update();

            const origPage = origDoc.pages[i];
            origPage.duplicate(LocationOptions.AFTER, newDoc.pages[-1]);
        }

        if (hasCancelled) {
            progressWin.close();
            if (newDoc && !newDoc.closed) newDoc.close(SaveOptions.NO);
            alert("⚠️ Conversion cancelled by user.\nNew document discarded.");
            return;
        }

        // Finalize new document
        app.activeDocument = newDoc;
        newDoc.layoutWindow.transformReferencePoint = origDoc.layoutWindow.transformReferencePoint;
        newDoc.baselineShift = origDoc.baselineShift;
        newDoc.gridPreferences = origDoc.gridPreferences;
        newDoc.guidesPreferences = origDoc.guidesPreferences;

        // Cleanup UI
        progressWin.info.text = "✅ Conversion complete!";
        progressWin.progress.value = origDoc.pages.length;
        progressWin.update();
        $.sleep(800);
        progressWin.close();

        // Success notification with page count
        alert(
            `✅ SUCCESS!\n\n` +
            `New single-page document created:\n` +
            `• ${newDoc.pages.length} pages (was ${origDoc.pages.length} in spreads)\n` +
            `• All content preserved visually\n` +
            `• Master items converted to static content\n` +
            `• Original document unchanged\n\n` +
            `💡 Tip: Save new document via File > Save As`,
            "Conversion Complete"
        );

    } catch (err) {
        progressWin.close();
        if (newDoc && !newDoc.closed) newDoc.close(SaveOptions.NO);
        alert(
            `❌ CONVERSION FAILED\n\nError: ${err.message}\n\n` +
            `Recommendations:\n` +
            `• Save all documents\n` +
            `• Close unnecessary apps\n` +
            `• Try with a simplified document copy`,
            "Script Error",
            true
        );
        $.writeln("Conversion error: " + err + "\nStack: " + err.stack);
    }
})();
